harness_checkout.scope: harness checkout at match start; not proof of either binary's build source

baseline.source_provenance_note: Commit is caller-declared and exists in this repository; the harness does not infer or prove the binary was built from it.

candidate.source_provenance_note: Commit is caller-declared and exists in this repository; the harness does not infer or prove the binary was built from it.

draw_policy_detail: Both players always claim an available threefold or 50-move draw, including an intended legal next move.

openings.name: Long time queen gambit paired bishops
Long time Caro advance central exchange

opening_document.provenance: Twelve familiar opening structures hand-authored before any evaluation, search, or game on these final starts. No external opening book or games are used. Names describe structures and do not certify best play. Only legality, nonterminal status, and prior pieces-only input exposure are used for acceptance; there is no random draw or seed.
opening_document.scope: A developer-selected sample of twelve opening structures, six White-to-move and six Black-to-move. The primary first two cover Spanish and Sicilian structures with one White-to-move and one Black-to-move position. The secondary first position is Spanish and White-to-move. Only these six games are planned; the remaining pool is unused. The small fixed samples do not define an Elo population.
opening_document.selection_policy: The twelve declared positions are a fixed candidate pool. Use only the fixed first two positions, with both engine colors, for the primary 3000 ms control (4 games). Use only the fixed first position, with both engine colors, for the secondary 5000 ms control (2 games). The user reduced the time budget before any new evaluation, search, or game; the existing position pool and order are preserved. Both sets are frozen before the first new search or game and never selected from results.

opening_selection: Ordered prefix fixed by invocation before results; both colors per opening.
pair_order: Each opening: candidate White, then candidate Black; openings in file order.
backtrack_definition: Adjacent engine-selected moves by the same side, both quiet non-pawn moves and neither a check evasion, form an opportunity. A->B then B->A by the same piece is a backtrack. Opening moves excluded. This is not a judgment that the reversal was unnecessary.
move_selection: Supplied binaries only; deterministic opening and color schedule; no runner move randomness.

summary.incomplete_scope: incomplete_games counts attempted unfinished games; unplayed_games counts scheduled games never started after an error.
summary.score_scope: Finite match score among completed games only; no Elo estimate.
summary.wilson_interpretation: Approximate descriptive Wilson interval with draws as half a success; independent Bernoulli assumptions do not hold for draws or paired openings and can overstate certainty.
summary.interval_policy: No uncertainty interval from this two/one-pair pilot; raw score only

external_engine_guard.scope: Zero observed external named engine CPU ticks; sampled process discovery. Unknown/transient engines between samples and non-engine host load are not excluded.

limits_scope: movetime_ms labels the neural candidate condition; actual per-role limits are role_movetime_ms, baseline always 1000ms
